svg.title: DDS standardized performance trend
svg.desc: Recorded performance entries showing cumulative runtime and per-board runtime across standardized runs and standalone alpha-mu baselines.
svg.text: Top panel: cumulative runtime. Bottom panel: per-board runtime for entries that record board counts.
Hollow X markers denote flagged historical outliers/non-comparable measurements and are excluded from the trend line for that workload.
Min/max range from recorded board times
